name: CICDBCMP.jcl
description:
This JCL job compiles a CICS DB2 program named CICSDB2P within the CardDemo application environment. It invokes a utility procedure (BLDCIDB2) to compile the COBOL source code, generate a Database Request Module (DBRM), and build a load module, binding it to the CARDDEMO plan on the DAZ1 DB2 subsystem.Key Functionalities:
Compiles the CICS DB2 COBOL program (CICSDB2P) from the source library AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL using the BLDCIDB2 build procedure
Generates a Database Request Module (DBRM) and stores it in the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DBRMLIB library for DB2 plan binding
Links and stores the compiled load module into the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB partitioned dataset for execution
Binds the compiled program to the CARDDEMO DB2 plan on subsystem DAZ1, enabling the program to execute DB2 SQL statements
References copybook members from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY and DB2 declarations from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DCL during compilation
